en: Black‑and‑white promotional postcard for a Swedish dance band. The front shows four men in matching dark double‑breasted suits with white turtlenecks posing outdoors among birch trees. The reverse is a standard divided back with a stamp box and Swedish text advertising the group, listing the bandleader's name and phone numbers, an agency in Nybro, and the photo/print shop Thornbergs Foto in Vimmerby.
